تستقضوا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْضُوا (tastaqḍū) /tas.taq.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# تُسْتَقْضَوْا (tustaqḍaw) /tus.taq.dˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
